notes: Seed URL works over https; all results are on page/shelby.Elections. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Server Last-Modified values differ by file and generally follow PDF creation times, so upload times are usable. The Electionware footer clock appears to run ahead of the server clock (the primary summary footer says 11:00 PM but the file was on the server at 10:36 PM CST; the precinct report footer says 6:29 PM Mar 4 but Last-Modified is 4:11 PM CST Mar 4); either way the primary precinct report is from Mar 4. Confidence med follows the pilot practice (Hudspeth) where at least one deciding election has both a printed run time and an election-night upload (the 2026 primary); the 2024 and runoff uploads are next-day.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER by check 2 (county totals only on or after election night, precinct reports the next day or never), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence med because the 2026 primary night report has a printed run time and an election-night upload time.
